U_0x00F4E2: A simplified mass-production Jinrai. Outwardly similar, it omits several features to cut costs, and its ABMD (artificial muscle drive) is fitted only in the legs. If the Jinrai is a chunin, this is a genin.
U_0x00F68F: A unit rebuilt from a captured Jinrai. The System ZLAI was removed, making it a manned machine with a DML (Direct Motion Link) system like DyGenGuard's. It also carries "System LIOH," a man-machine interface that learns a pilot's traits to draw out latent ability, doubling as control OS and troop-training system. Boosters made for DyGenGuard and Aussenseiter are fitted to its legs, and since pilot Touma excels at martial arts, it fights with kicks rather than the Jinrai's weapons.
U_0x00FA5A: The 7th prototype TE Absorber of the "Tsentr Project." An <S.Unit>-type machine that excels in close combat. Its Terminus Energy-based TE engine has many output-regulation problems, so its joints are partly battery-driven. To fine-tune output and assist control, a DFC (Direct Feeling Control) system is used, with a suited operator riding aboard. A second unit exists, but serves mainly as spare parts and goes unused.
U_0x00FDBB:
The 9th prototype TE Absorber of the "Tsentr Project," consisting of a main body built from data on the 7th prototype Garmraid, plus the unmanned weapon "Machine Animalito." A new TE engine adds output and stability, and the "TE Sphere" energy field raises defense.
The Machine Animalito comprises the bird-type fighter "Hiou" and the wolf-type "Rouga." Each can operate alone, but they normally split into parts worn on Garmraid Blaze's arms, legs, shoulders and back.
With Rouga's head as a striking weapon on the right arm and Hiou as a wing booster on the back, it becomes "Form G," which, like Garmraid, excels in close combat.
